pay_detail: $450 covers meals, dorm housing, T-shirt, music and supplies
name: VT Summer Strings
org: Virginia Tech School of Performing Arts (VT String Project)
what_you_do: A weekend mini camp for string players. You play chamber music and new orchestra pieces. You also do a 3D immersive sound project in the university audio lab. You stay in a campus dorm.
who_can_apply: Rising 9th to 12th graders with at least two years of lessons on violin, viola, cello or double bass.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was June 12-14, 2026. 2027 dates and registration not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Registration information is not posted yet (the 2026 page said it was coming soon). Questions: stringproject@vt.edu.
notes: Dates are last year's. The page said registration information was coming soon.
